channel.title: Cribl, Inc. — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Cribl, Inc. (cribl).

item.title: CVE-2026-115903 · 7.1 HIGH — Improper access control in Cribl Edge file search
item.description: An authenticated attacker must reach the Edge file APIs through the Leader or directly on an Edge node. On affected managed Edge deployments with RBAC, Read Only access permits these calls. Disclosure is limited to files readable by the Edge process…

item.title: CVE-2026-115901 · 9 CRITICAL — Cross-site scripting in the Cribl Stream OIDC callback
item.description: Exploitation requires an identity admitted to a configured trusted IdP application, control of claims selected as the OIDC user identifier, acceptance by configured SSO filters, and a victim with an active Cribl session following a crafted authentica…

item.title: CVE-2026-115900 · 8.8 HIGH — Prototype pollution in Cribl Stream Worker heartbeats
item.description: An attacker must possess a valid Worker distribution credential, reach the Leader distribution listener, and send crafted authenticated Worker heartbeats. Where mTLS client authentication is enforced, an accepted client certificate and its private ke…

item.title: CVE-2026-115899 · 9.8 CRITICAL — Code injection in Cribl Stream REST Collector pagination
item.description: An attacker must control pagination data returned by an upstream API or service queried by an existing REST Collector. The Collector must use affected response-based pagination and process the crafted data during a job run. Successful exploitation ex…

item.title: CVE-2026-115873 · 9.9 CRITICAL — Code injection in the Cribl Stream nested expression compiler
item.description: A remote attacker must authenticate with Read Only (GroupRead) access to at least one Worker Group and reach the Leader API. A crafted expression can exploit the nested compiler to bypass expression restrictions and execute code with the Leader servi…

item.title: CVE-2026-56748 · 8.7 HIGH — Authenticated RCE via Symlink Following in Cribl Stream Pack Git Import
item.description: Improper validation of symbolic links in the Pack Git import feature in Cribl Stream before 4.18.2 allows a remote authenticated attacker with Pack import and pipeline preview permissions to execute arbitrary code as the Cribl server process via a cr…

item.title: CVE-2026-56747 · 8.8 HIGH — Code Injection in JSON Pointer Processing Component in Cribl Stream
item.description: Improper control of generation of code in the JSON Pointer-to-accessor compiler in Cribl Stream before 4.18.2 allows a remote authenticated attacker with edit privileges to execute arbitrary JavaScript on the server via a crafted database connection…

item.title: CVE-2026-45393 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Local privilege escalation to SYSTEM in Cribl Edge for Windows
item.description: A vulnerability chain in Cribl Edge for Windows before 4.17.1 allows a local authenticated user to escalate privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. Incorrect default permissions on the Windows installer's authentication directory (CWE-276) expose a crypto…

item.title: CVE-2026-45392 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — DOM-based XSS in Cribl Stream
item.description: DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) in Cribl Stream before 4.17.1 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of an authenticated user who is tricked into visiting a crafted URL and interacting with the page.

item.title: CVE-2026-45391 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Local privilege escalation in Cribl Edge for Linux
item.description: A command injection vulnerability in Cribl Edge for Linux versions 3.2.0 through 4.17.0 allows a local unprivileged user to execute arbitrary commands in the context of the Cribl Edge service account.
